## Summary

Describe the change and why it is needed.

## Change type

- [ ] Website or Python tooling
- [ ] Documentation
- [ ] Research record or source ledger
- [ ] Other

## Evidence and review

For research-content changes, list the public source URLs and explain what they support. Keep direct citations, reconstructed links, candidate analyses, and later-paper relationships distinct. State unresolved limitations.

## Before requesting review

- [ ] I updated the editable source data and regenerated `web/data/seed.js` if the browser seed changed.
- [ ] I have not included controlled-access data, personal information, confidential correspondence, or copyrighted full text.
- [ ] I have not described a candidate dataset as scientifically validated without a documented feasibility review.
- [ ] I ran the relevant validation commands from `CONTRIBUTING.md`, or explained why I could not.
- [ ] For website changes, I included a screenshot or a short description of the visual change.
